messages:
alex: Heads-up: finished an offline traceplay run comparing queue_policy="size-priority" vs "age-priority". Sim results favored size-priority for throughput, but replaying prod traces shows worse tail due to KV warmup churn. Notes below.

maria: Can you paste the perf diffs? numbers?

alex: Paste of main perf summary from the replay:```
replayer run-id: rp-2026-11-03
size-priority: p50=38ms p95=220ms p99=450ms
age-priority: p50=42ms p95=190ms p99=210ms
kernel_switches: size-priority +18% (more dynamic kernel swaps on seq>512)
kv_miss_rate: size-priority 12% (up) vs age-priority 6%
```

ben: Interesting — size-priority forms larger batches but causes more cross-session mixing and KV evictions, right?

alex: Exactly. In the traceplay run we used token_budget=1024 which lets large batches form; that mixes sequences from different sessions/shards and evicts hot KV entries. Real prod has bursts of long-context requests making the effect worse.

sophie: Ok — two tuning levers: reduce token_budget target or bias batch formation for session locality. Did you try per-session coalescing?

alex: I ran another sweep with token_budget=512 + session_coalesce=true. Better: size-priority p95 -> 170ms, p99 improved but kernel selection still oscillates for seq>1024. Config snippet:```
replayer_config:
  token_budget: 512
  session_coalesce: true
  queue_policy: size-priority
```

joel: Can we make kernel selection deterministic in the replayer? Runtime picks kernels based on batch sequence-length histogram; if a batch mixes lengths above the threshold it switches to a slower fallback kernel. That switch is what spikes tail.

perf-bot: Perf regression alert: canary with size-priority + token_budget=1024 showed +12% p99 on model-x (run rp-2026-11-03T12:02Z). See perf dashboard link.

maria: We need an A/B harness that runs both queue policies on the same trace set and captures KV hit/miss, kernel_switch_count, and full latency distribution. Also include warmup TTL and token_budget sweeps.

ben: I'll add KV access heatmap logging and kernel_switch_rate per-minute to the harness. That should let us correlate evictions -> kernel swaps -> tail.

alex: Plan: 1) Run A/B replayer for 48h with representative prod traces (subset ~10% heavy traces). 2) Sweep token_budget in [256,512,1024] and session_coalesce={0,1}. 3) Collect p50/p95/p99, kv_miss_rate, kernel_switch_rate, eviction_rate. 4) If size-priority only wins at small token_budget, adopt hybrid default: size-priority with token_budget cap 512 + session_coalesce=true. Thoughts?

sophie: Agree. Also propose a short-circuit fallback: if kv_miss_rate > 10% over a 1-minute window, switch queue_policy -> age-priority for 5m. That avoids long tails during warmup storms.

maria: I'll wire up the AB harness + dashboard and kick off runs. Assigning: @ben for logs/telemetry, @alex for replayer configs. ETA Monday.

ben: On it — will post run id and log links when queued.

sophie: :thumbsup:
